CREATE TABLE "public"."departments" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."employee_audit_events" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actorId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "details" text,
  "employeeId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "employee_audit_events_action_check_9545292c" CHECK ("action" IN ('CREATED', 'UPDATED', 'STATUS_CHANGED', 'TERMINATED', 'SALARY_CREATED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."employees" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "departmentId" text,
  "employeeCode" text NOT NULL,
  "employmentType" text NOT NULL,
  "firstName" text NOT NULL,
  "hireDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "jobTitle" text NOT NULL,
  "lastName" text NOT NULL,
  "linkedUserId" text,
  "managerId" text,
  "organizationId" text NOT NULL,
  "phoneNumber" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "terminationDate" timestamptz,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "workEmail" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "employees_employmentType_check_a3ef5608" CHECK ("employmentType" IN ('FULL_TIME', 'PART_TIME', 'CONTRACT', 'INTERN')),
  CONSTRAINT "employees_status_check_fa83b510" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'ON_LEAVE', 'INACTIVE', 'TERMINATED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."salary_components" (
  "amount" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "organizationId" text NOT NULL,
  "salaryStructureId" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "salary_components_type_check_950f4ce8" CHECK ("type" IN ('EARNING', 'DEDUCTION'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."salary_structures" (
  "baseAmount" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "compensationType" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" text NOT NULL,
  "currency" text NOT NULL,
  "effectiveFrom" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "effectiveTo" timestamptz,
  "employeeId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "organizationId" text NOT NULL,
  "payFrequency" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "salary_structures_compensationType_check_1a0d65c2" CHECK ("compensationType" IN ('FIXED_SALARY', 'HOURLY')),
  CONSTRAINT "salary_structures_payFrequency_check_01d702e4" CHECK ("payFrequency" IN ('MONTHLY', 'BIWEEKLY', 'WEEKLY'))
)
